---
title: "uv-python basic example"
engine: uv-python
format: html
---

This example renders ordinary Python chunks through `uv run`, without Jupyter.

```{python}
#| echo: true
x = 40
print("first chunk set x")
```

The next chunk sees state from the first chunk.

```{python}
print(f"shared state result: {x + 2}")
```

Hidden chunks still execute when `include: false`.

```{python}
#| include: false
hidden_value = "hidden execution worked"
```

```{python}
print(hidden_value)
```

Chunks with `output: false` execute but suppress their captured output.

```{python}
#| output: false
suppressed_value = 7
print("this output should be suppressed")
```

```{python}
print(f"suppressed chunk state: {suppressed_value}")
```

Stderr is captured as text output as well.

```{python}
import sys

sys.stderr.write("stderr validation message\n")
```

Chunks with `eval: false` do not execute, but can echo source.

```{python}
#| eval: false
#| echo: true
print("this chunk should not execute")
```

Matplotlib figures are captured as static PNG files.

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.figure()
plt.plot([1, 2, 3], [1, 4, 9])
plt.title("uv-python matplotlib PNG")
```
